description: This file contains a static helper class 'AssetsHelper' providing utility functions to locate and verify the assets folder within a project, primarily for font or resource management in PDF processing.

classes.name: AssetsHelper
classes.description: A static class with helper functions for locating and validating the assets directory.

methods.name: GetAssetsFolder
methods.description: Locates the 'assets' folder starting from the specified path or current directory if null, moving up the directory hierarchy if not found.

methods.name: EnsureAssets
methods.description: Verifies that the 'assets' folder exists and is not empty; throws an exception if it does not meet these conditions.
